schema: MEH Studio fixed-view visual audit v1
method: Known-build photographs define construction traits and forbidden visual failures. Fixed-camera application renders are reviewed beside them, while analytic and mesh gates verify contact, clearance, cavity continuity, and printable topology.
resolvedDuringAudit: The full-assembly review renderer exposed external pod crescents through an opaque horn. Build 619 now hides external hardware in the mouth view and exposes it only in Ghost, Mount, and Section.
Capture mode removes controls and reports from the frame so geometry cannot be hidden by the narrow side-viewer layout.

checks.name: true planar angular walls
two external woofer frames seated on relieved panel lands
four literal racetrack apertures with no colored cutter objects
mouth view contains no driver plates or floating bodies
two 12-inch drivers remain outside the horn air path
18 mm inner flare panels are the direct sealed driver-bearing mounts
four rounded rectangular entries remain close to the common throat-side station
section view shows continuous adapter-to-wall passages

cases.title: Calculated four-woofer perpendicular radial hub - integrated

checks.name: four woofer axes are perpendicular to the HF axis and aimed into one hub
drivers are seated on compact external cone-following pods without overlap
mouth view shows only the circular HF throat and four literal entries
section view shows short wall-to-chamber cavities

cases.title: Calculated four-woofer perpendicular radial hub - detachable

checks.name: one independently sealed adapter exists per woofer
gasket seams distinguish detachable modules from the integrated solid
driver faces remain outside the horn wall
horn plus four modules is the expected five-part export
four complete driver frames clear one another in 3D
eight edge-biased literal entries stay under active cone area
mounting lands remain behind planar horn walls
full view stays free of external hardware
